name: delphi-cross-socket
description: Delphi cross-platform async socket library (IOCP/epoll/kqueue) with HTTP server and OpenSSL 3.x support. Fork of winddriver/Delphi-Cross-Socket that adds only a Boss manifest and the vendored CnPack subset; the code is upstream's (synced to 12846a1, 2026-10-08, which includes the merged PRs #205-#208).
